'''Reshig''' lived on [[Andasala/Legends|Andasala]] with his wife and children. He borrowed money from the [[loan shark]] [[Sires Vant]] and attempted to leave the planet when he was unable to repay the loan. [[Vexan]], a corrupt [[Constable/Legends|constable]] in Vant's employ, stopped him from leaving.
